subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: East the Direction of Dawn
description: One-minute skill: East the Direction of Dawn.

hook.text: The sun rises in the east. That's where most cultures placed life, beginnings, and sacred orientation.

buildup.text: Christian churches face east. Muslim prayers face Mecca—east for much of the Islamic world. Dawn draws worship.

discovery.text: The word 'Easter' may relate to 'east' and the dawn goddess Ēostre. Resurrection and sunrise share a direction.

twist.text: East also means danger in some myths. Journeying east leads to strange lands—Persia for Greeks, China for Europeans.

climax.text: East is the direction of both origin and the unknown. Every sunrise is a beginning and a reminder of mystery.

punchline.text: Face the dawn. That's where it begins.

quiz.question: Why do most Christian churches face east?
options: To face the direction of the sunrise and resurrection
